# Fress — Free & Open-Source Software Directory

> Fress (https://fress.app) is an open-source, privacy-first directory of curated free and open-source software (FOSS). It provides verified zero-telemetry software alternatives to proprietary tools, complete with one-click package manager install scripts (Winget, Homebrew, Flatpak), and a dedicated Android FOSS catalog.

## Primary Entities & Categorical Alternatives

### 1. Productivity & Office
- **Obsidian**: Local markdown knowledge base. Replaces Notion, Evernote. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android. Install: `winget install Obsidian.Obsidian` / `brew install --cask obsidian` / `flatpak install flathub md.obsidian.Obsidian`.
- **LibreOffice**: Complete offline office suite. Replaces Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Available on Windows, macOS, Linux.
- **Logseq**: Local-first privacy outliner and graph notes. Replaces Roam Research. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.
- **Joplin**: Encrypted note taking with end-to-end sync. Replaces Evernote, OneNote. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.

### 2. Utilities & System
- **voidtools Everything**: Instant filename search engine for Windows. Replaces Windows Search.
- **LocalSend**: Cross-platform local network file sharing using WiFi. Replaces Apple AirDrop, ShareIt. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.
- **Microsoft PowerToys**: Windows productivity suite (FancyZones, Text Extractor OCR, PowerToys Run).
- **7-Zip**: High compression ratio file archiver with AES-256 encryption. Replaces WinRAR.
- **Syncthing**: Continuous decentralized peer-to-peer file synchronization. Replaces Dropbox, Google Drive sync. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.

### 3. Privacy & Security
- **Bitwarden**: Audited open-source zero-knowledge cloud password manager. Replaces 1Password, LastPass. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Web.
- **KeePassXC**: 100% offline encrypted local password database (.kdbx). Replaces 1Password. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux.
- **Cryptomator**: Client-side encryption for cloud storage vaults. Replaces Boxcryptor. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.

### 4. Design & Creative
- **Blender**: Industry-standard 3D creation and VFX suite. Replaces Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux.
- **Krita**: Professional raster digital painting software. Replaces Corel Painter, Photoshop.
- **Inkscape**: Vector graphics editor. Replaces Adobe Illustrator.
- **Penpot**: Web-based collaborative UI/UX prototyping. Replaces Figma.
- **GIMP**: Image manipulation and photo editing. Replaces Adobe Photoshop.

### 5. Media, Audio & Video
- **VLC Media Player**: Universal multimedia player without external codecs. Replaces Windows Media Player. Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.
- **OBS Studio**: Live streaming and video screen recording. Replaces Camtasia, XSplit.
- **Audacity**: Multi-track audio editor. Replaces Adobe Audition.
- **HandBrake**: Open-source video transcoder. Replaces Adobe Media Encoder.

### 6. AI & Knowledge
- **Jan**: 100% offline local AI assistant running GGUF models. Replaces ChatGPT Desktop.
- **Ollama**: Local CLI and daemon for running Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, and DeepSeek.
- **LM Studio**: Visual desktop GUI for downloading and running local language models.

### 7. Android Open-Source Software
- **LocalSend**: Cross-platform local file sharing over Wi-Fi without internet.
- **Bitwarden**: Full autofill password management on Android.
- **Joplin**: Mobile encrypted notes with WebDAV and Nextcloud sync.
- **VLC for Android**: Plays any video/audio format on mobile devices.
- **Syncthing**: Synchronize folders between Android phone and desktop without cloud storage.
- **NewPipe**: Lightweight privacy frontend for streaming media.

## Technical Specifications
- **Licensing**: All listed tools are Free and Open Source (MIT, GPL, Apache-2.0, MPL, BSD) or clean freeware with zero telemetry.
- **Package Managers**: Native support for Windows Package Manager (`winget`), macOS Homebrew (`brew`), and Linux Flatpak (`flatpak`).
- **Live Search & Registry**: Allows instant addition of any GitHub repository to local user catalog.
